Ingrid Johansson  
Senior DevOps Engineer / Site Reliability Consultant | NexaTech Solutions  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 52 345 6789 | ingrid.johansson@nexatech.co.il | linkedin.com/in/ingridjohansson  
---  
**Professional Experience**  
At NexaTech Solutions, I lead the design and implementation of scalable, resilient infrastructure for enterprise clients, focusing on Kubernetes-native architectures, cloud cost optimization, and incident management frameworks. Over the past three years, I have orchestrated the migration of 12+ high-traffic applications to Kubernetes, achieving a 40% reduction in infrastructure costs and a 99.95% SLA adherence rate. My work on load balancing strategies for distributed microservices has consistently improved system availability by 25%, while my leadership in incident management processes has reduced mean time to resolution (MTTR) by 35% across cross-functional teams.  

Prior to joining NexaTech, I served as a Senior DevOps Consultant at InfraLogic, where I spearheaded the automation of CI/CD pipelines for 8+ SaaS platforms, reducing deployment cycles from 4 hours to under 15 minutes. My expertise in Terraform enabled the creation of dynamic infrastructure-as-code templates, which cut provisioning time by 60% and eliminated configuration drift in 100% of client environments. At CloudForge Consulting, I architected monitoring solutions using Prometheus and Grafana, integrating real-time metrics into dashboards that allowed teams to proactively identify bottlenecks, leading to a 20% improvement in system performance.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden (Graduated: 2016)  
---  
**Professional Summary**  
A seasoned DevOps engineer with a proven track record of delivering mission-critical systems at scale, I specialize in Kubernetes architecture, cloud cost optimization, and incident management. My career has been defined by the development of robust CI/CD pipelines, the automation of infrastructure-as-code processes, and the implementation of SLA/SLO frameworks that align with business objectives. With a deep understanding of distributed systems and a commitment to operational excellence, I have consistently driven measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency across large-scale enterprise environments.  

**Projects**  
- **Kubernetes Cluster Optimization**: Redesigned the architecture of a global e-commerce platform’s Kubernetes clusters, integrating automated scaling and self-healing mechanisms. This reduced downtime by 50% and improved resource utilization by 35%.  
- **Cloud Cost Optimization Framework**: Developed a proprietary tool to analyze and optimize cloud spend, resulting in a 30% reduction in monthly AWS costs for a fintech client.  
- **Incident Management Overhaul**: Implemented a centralized incident response system using Slack and PagerDuty, reducing communication latency during outages by 40%.  
- **CI/CD Pipeline Modernization**: Refactored legacy pipelines for a healthcare SaaS provider, integrating GitOps practices and reducing deployment errors by 70%.

- Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect  
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)  
- ITIL Foundation Certification
